See what to expect By Gandharv Walia , Global Desk Last Updated: Nov 08, 2026, 05:10:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis North of North Season 3 has not been officially renewed by Netflix, CBC or APTN. Siaja is trying to reconnect with her sister Olivia in the Season 2. Siaja is also in a relationship with Kuuk while Neevee is reconnecting with Alistair. Siaja also gets a new role in the community.

 High Potential Season 3 and Special Episode: Release date, time, cast, crew and where to watch 
 North of North Season 3 has not been announced yet. Siaja receives a message from her sister Olivia in Season 2. She kisses Kuuk at the Winter Ball while Neevee and Alistair decide to give their relationship another shot.
 North of North Season 3: What to expect?
Season 2 focused on Siaja becoming independent and trying to reconnect her mother Neevee with Olivia. Season 3 may focus on Olivia as she is trying to reconnect with her mother and sister on her own terms. Their relationship was a big part of Season 2 and there is scope for more development.
 There is also the relationship between Siaja and Kuuk to look out for. They have had some good chemistry in the series but have been distracted and had bad timing. They kissed each other at the Winter Ball. It could be the start of their relationship.
Anna Lambe has said what she would like to see in another season. She said she wants to see Siaja become more thoughtful and caring in her efforts to reconnect with her mother and sister in an interview with TV Insider.
Siaja hides who she is and her connection to her family while meeting with Olivia in Season 2. Lambe wants to see how Siaja creates space for the two women to reconnect.
 Is North of North renewed for Season 3?
North of North has not been renewed for Season 3. It is not just Netflix that decides if it will be renewed as it is co-commissioned by CBC and Netflix in association with APTN.
The three companies renewed the series for Season 2. Anna Lambe announced the renewal on social media on the April 29, 2025 around 3 weeks after Season 1 premiered on Netflix.
The show's two seasons were released on CBC and APTN before it was released on Netflix. The episodes premiered on APTN+ on September 1, 2026 and then on CBC TV, CBC Gem and APTN TV on September 8. This means they will have data on how many people have watched the series before Netflix get their full stats.
